description: This source file defines a React custom hook named 'useLlmCostsHierarchy' used to fetch hierarchical large language model (LLM) costs data from a backend API endpoint. It manages internal state for data, loading status, and errors, and provides a refetch function. The hook supports an optional 'filter' parameter to customize the API query.

methods.name: useLlmCostsHierarchy({ filter } = {})
methods.description: React hook for fetching and managing hierarchical LLM costs data, with support for filtering and refetching.
